plan.notes: Source: ATA Career Education Spring Hill catalog (Lic. #3957), effective July 1, 2026 — 'PROGRAMS OF STUDY' section (catalog pp.45-58), hand-transcribed 2026-09-30 from the official PDF. QUARTER CREDIT HOURS: the catalog is a quarter-credit school (programs measured in 10-week quarters; e.g. the AOS degrees are '70 weeks' = 7 quarters). All credit values here are quarter credit hours, NOT semester credits. TERM GROUPING: the catalog publishes the complete required course list in two groupings ('Basic Requirements' and 'Program Requirements') with per-course credit hours, but it does not publish an official quarter-by-quarter schedule — it states: 'Pre-requisites are not established, rather students are scheduled by ATA based upon the program plan template.' The two terms below follow the catalog's own Basic/Program grouping verbatim; they are not an invented quarter schedule. No course prerequisites are established by the catalog, so no prereqs are mapped. The catalog's course-numbering note ('100-110 courses are typically taken at the beginning of the program, courses 120-150 will be scheduled for the middle sequence') is the only sequencing guidance given. Course titles cross-checked against the catalog's Course Descriptions section (pp.59-79). Diploma, 49.5 quarter credits, 40 weeks, residential delivery. Note: the catalog's program table prints EIT125 as 'Alternation Current and Passive Devices'; the catalog's own Course Descriptions section (p.66) titles it 'Alternating Current and Passive Devices', which is used here.
